claims.label: EpiFEG-associated reduced susceptibility to epidermin
claims.note: The tested subjects are TM300-derived laboratory strains, not the unmodified background. Staphylococcus epidermidis Tue3298 is the donor. The three-component result does not establish individual sufficiency; transport remains a hypothesis. Donor references UniProtKB:Q54002 (EpiF), UniProtKB:Q54003 (EpiE) and UniProtKB:Q54004 (EpiG) are not experimental allele assignments. ENA lists the paper's U29130 as a secondary accession of U77778. No derivative TaxID, genome, numerical AST or clinical category is assigned.
claims.phenotype_label: reduced susceptibility to epidermin in laboratory derivatives

claims.label: MccF-associated enzymatic inactivation of microcin C
claims.note: Primary product analysis supports cleavage of intact microcin C. Deformylated material was also present and separately discussed; this is not a pure-compound organismal AST claim. The paper distinguishes intact, processed and analogue substrates. Reference candidates remain separate from the experimental proteins. NCBITaxon:562 denotes the E. coli reference species, not a strain or genome. BL21(DE3) is a reported host background, not an exact derivative assignment. No clinical category or numerical AST is inferred.
